verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes an official Agent Toolkit with TypeScript/Python SDKs supporting OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock, Vercel AI SDK, and MCP, plus a GitHub repo, REST API docs, sandbox environment, and pre-built agent tool functions (orders, refunds, disputes, catalog). This is corroborated by independent GitHub evidence, not just vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on reviews/tutorials of building against the SDK beyond PayPal's own docs and repo, and clarity on SDK versioning/maturity/production track record.
